marking.appearance_status: DG419 is an illustrative partial device-family identifier, not a verified full top marking. Exact physical marking is unconfirmed; suffix, logo, date and traceability are omitted and typography and placement are illustrative.

recipe.appearance_status: Illustrative KiCad SOIC-8 model; Vishay SOIC8 drawing 5498 specifies 1.75 mm maximum height. Catalogue source does not specify height. Not a verified mechanical model or PCB footprint.

studio.note: Electronics adaptation of the screw product studio: three softboxes, orthographic framing, neutral floor and filmic highlights. Does not claim identical Blender AgX colour management.
